lean.statement:
(f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hs : HasCompactSupport f) :
    let γ : Measure ℝ := gaussianReal 0 1
    (∫ x, (f x)^2 * Real.log ((f x)^2) ∂γ) -
      (∫ x, (f x)^2 ∂γ) * Real.log (∫ x, (f x)^2 ∂γ) ≤
    2 * ∫ x, (deriv f x)^2 ∂γ
approved_definition_context: All functions and derivatives are on the real line with its canonical Borel structure. ContDiff Real 2 f means C2; HasCompactSupport f means compact closure of nonzero support. deriv is the real derivative.

gamma=gaussianReal0 1 is the actual mean-zero variance-one real probability Gaussian. Integrals are real Bochner integrals. Real.log is the totalized real logarithm; the expression t*log(t) is defined at zero and continuous there.
The entropy expression is the displayed homogeneous integral of f squared times its log minus mass times log mass. No normalized-density/KL identification is part of this conclusion.

The only caller analytic inputs are C2 and compact support. Signed and zero functions are included. No positivity, normalization, integrability, law, inequality or limit certificate is supplied. The numerical coefficient is exactly2.
